label: OM3501 passive 10G-SR multimode fibre TAP (1 tap, 50/50, LC)
description: Passive 1-tap optical splitter for a duplex OM3 multimode link at 100M/1G/10G: the two network LC ports pass traffic through unpowered and each direction is split 50/50 onto its own monitor LC port. No power, no IP stack, no management - it is a pure optical coupler, so a dead tap cannot drop the live link.
